author: Don't Look
issue: radial menu opens and highlights a selection but selected action does not execute in Steam and NoSteam v18.13
root_cause: DynamicRadialMenu action DisplayName FText entries were translated even though AC_RadialMenu.HandleItemSelected converts DisplayName to FString and dispatches through exact English string comparisons.

source_evidence.W_MenuItem_SetItemText: sets TXT_Item from the Item FText parameter; current cooked widget has no separate safe localized display-ID boundary

fix: Restore only the seven DT_Menu action-identifier locres values to their original English strings while preserving exact Namespace + Key + SourceStringHash. Keep all other localization and cooked UI payloads unchanged.
why_not_binary_patch: No AC_RadialMenu bytecode/string-switch patch was introduced, avoiding build-specific control-flow edits.
display_tradeoff: The seven command captions remain English because the game reuses the same FText as both visible label and runtime identifier. Russian display aliases are retained for a future safe display-boundary implementation.
